about: Starter sounds for Deluge Synth, written in Tone.js terms (seconds, Hz, Q, octaves) and turned into Deluge presets by tools/make_starter.py. The first four are the melodic voices of LJam (ljam/src/synths.js). Ours, GPL-3.0-or-later like the rest of the repository.

voices.name: LJam Bass
voices.notes: Resonant saw with a snappy filter envelope over a sine sub an octave down. In LJam the sub skips the filter and has its own envelope; here both oscillators share them.

voices.name: LJam Lead
voices.notes: Three detuned saws through a filter envelope and a light chorus.

voices.name: LJam Pad
voices.notes: Wide saws, slow amplitude and filter swell, deep chorus. Wants reverb.

voices.name: LJam Arp
voices.notes: A plucked square, resonant filter snapping shut. Wants a dotted delay.
